notes: Text only. Upward from the carrier, as the process leaves it: thick oxide, M3, M2, TiN, M1, Si, BOX. The order is stated; every BEOL height, thickness and lateral position is drafted.

Whether M1 or M2 contacts the TiN is not stated, so no contact is drawn at this plane. Heater offset from the waveguide not stated. The heated waveguide (Si or SiN) is not stated either: Si strip drafted.
The paper credits the very thick BOX for the 15.5 mW per pi; no thermal design data is given.
